name: Watmel Berry
description: {POKEBLOCK} ingredient. Plant in loamy soil to grow Watmel.

gifts.note:
Once a day: tell her a saying. The Berry Master's wife, in their house on Route 123, asks for a good saying once a day and gives a random Berry for any answer. Five sayings each earn a rare Berry the first time:
Spelon Berry: GREAT BATTLE
Pamtre Berry: CHALLENGE CONTEST (CONTEST unlocks after the Hall of Fame)
Watmel Berry: OVERWHELMING LATIAS (you must have seen Latias)
Durin Berry: COOL LATIOS (you must have seen Latios)
Belue Berry: SUPER HUSTLE (SUPER unlocks after the Hall of Fame)
The Berry Master himself gives two random Berries a day.
